_comment: Open-data and imagery sources used beside OpenStreetMap for this venue. The builder reads this file on every build to wire datasets and credits. Official website data is fetched by `npm run venues:research -- big-kahunas --fetch` into official-cache.json in this package. Official park maps live under maps/.

sources.used_for: Park geometry, named water slides, pools, paths, buildings, and the venue boundary.
Walking paths OpenStreetMap does not draw, and ride positions where OSM names geometry but not the attraction.
Food, restroom, and river labels; walking paths and ride entrances when georeferenced (illustrated / not-to-scale — use TPS). Primary map for builder testing and production georef.
Height requirements and attraction names for the 2026 season.

adapters.ropedrop: RopeDrop open data covers Disney/Universal parks only — not applicable to this water park.
adapters.parks-api: ThemeParks.wiki has no entity for Big Kahuna's Destin — inventory comes from official_site + OSM.
adapters.rcdb: RCDB is coaster-focused; this water park has no roller coasters to compare.
adapters.queue-times: Queue-Times does not list Big Kahuna's Destin — wait/inventory QA N/A.

research.note: LLM may propose aliases and height candidates from official HTML; code decides. LLM park-map search is required to locate guest-map image/PDF assets for tracing. Never invents coordinates.
